description: This file defines a Flutter widget OrdersScreen that displays a list of previous orders. It fetches order data upon initialization, shows a loading indicator while fetching, and presents the list of orders with details such as order ID, total price, status, and creation date. It uses Provider for state management and localization for multi-language support.

classes.name: OrdersScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of user orders.

classes.name: _OrdersScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and data fetching for OrdersScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers fetching orders after the first frame.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the screen, including loading indicator and list of orders.
